description:
Manage your iLok-activated software licenses and activations.

iLok License Manager manages iLok-enabled software licenses. It lets you activate and deactivate licenses to fit your workflow, whether to an iLok USB Smart Key, to a computer, or to the iLok Cloud where supported by the publisher, and move your licenses to where they are the most convenient for you.
[Added] Support for macOS 27.
[Improved] Improved stability of both iLok License Manager and Activation Experience.
[Improved] Modernized License Support installers for macOS.
[Fixed] Corrected the code signature of the License Support uninstaller application.
[Fixed] iLok account credentials are fully cleared when you sign out in iLok License Manager.
[Fixed] On Windows, the Sign In dialog in iLok License Manager no longer flashes.
